situation.name: zombie_outbreak_basic
situation.description: Basic model for zombie infection with three compartments: Susceptible, Zombie, and Removed. Includes birth rate, background death, zombie transmission, zombie destruction, and resurrection of removed individuals.

article.name: When Zombies Attack!: Mathematical Modelling of an Outbreak of Zombie Infection
article.author: Munz, P., Hudea, I., Imad, J., Smith?, R.J.

data.name: zombie_outbreak_simulation
data.source: Infectious Disease Modelling Research Progress, Nova Science Publishers, pp. 133-150

params.name: transmission_rate
params.meaning: Zombie transmission rate through contact with susceptibles

params.name: zombie_destruction_rate
params.meaning: Rate at which susceptibles destroy zombies (defeat rate)

params.name: resurrection_rate
params.meaning: Rate at which removed individuals resurrect as zombies

situation.name: zombie_outbreak_latent
situation.description: SIZR model with latent infection period. Susceptibles first become infected (bitten) before turning into zombies. Includes a latent class I with progression rate rho.

article.name: When Zombies Attack!: Mathematical Modelling of an Outbreak of Zombie Infection
article.author: Munz, P., Hudea, I., Imad, J., Smith?, R.J.

data.name: zombie_latent_simulation

params.meaning: Rate at which susceptibles destroy zombies

params.name: resurrection_rate
params.meaning: Resurrection rate of removed as zombies

params.name: zombification_rate
params.meaning: Rate at which infected become zombies (1/latent period)

situation.name: zombie_outbreak_quarantine
situation.description: SIZRQ model with quarantine. Quarantined individuals (infected and zombies) are removed from population and cannot infect. Includes escape attempts from quarantine.

article.name: When Zombies Attack!: Mathematical Modelling of an Outbreak of Zombie Infection
article.author: Munz, P., Hudea, I., Imad, J., Smith?, R.J.

situation.name: zombie_outbreak_cure
situation.description: SIZR model with cure/treatment. Zombies can be cured and return to susceptible class. Cure does not provide immunity.

situation.name: zombie_outbreak_impulsive
situation.description: Basic zombie model with impulsive eradication. Periodic coordinated attacks destroy a fraction of zombies at discrete time intervals with increasing kill ratios.
